scripts.openapi:bundle: npm run openapi:bundle:m0 && npm run openapi:bundle:m1 && npm run openapi:bundle:m2
scripts.openapi:lint: npm run openapi:lint:m0 && npm run openapi:lint:m1 && npm run openapi:lint:m2
scripts.openapi:build: npm run openapi:bundle && npm run openapi:types
scripts.build: npm run openapi:build && npm run build --workspaces --if-present

scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:m0 && npm run test:e2e:m1-control && npm run test:e2e:m1-gateway && npm run test:e2e:m1-client && npm run test:e2e:m2-control && npm run test:e2e:m2-agent && npm run test:e2e:runtime && npm run test:e2e:m3-data-plane
